title: Nothing Gets Through
html:
A slide shut the gold mine out in the Wastelands. The only man still trying to open it is working with tools that gave up on him years ago.

About

Given byWilson Barthrone
Level15
LengthLong
KindStory
Quest points3
UnlocksAgauton Mine

What you need

Bring Wilson Barthrone one of these gold items:

  • Gold Arms (gauntlets) · Armor Smithing 33
  • Gold Sword (short sword) · Weapon Smithing 33
  • Gold Scribing Quill · Tool Smithing 31

It must be Excellent quality or better (Excellent, Superior, Flawless).

Any character on your account, or anyone in your guild, can make it.

Reported by players who finished it; the game does not list it until you are on the quest. The Quality & enchanting calculator shows your chance of that quality.

Steps

  1. Talk to Wilson Barthrone (outdoors near Agauton) to get the quest.
  2. Get Gold Arms, Gold Sword or Gold Scribing Quill, Excellent quality or better.
  3. Bring it back to Wilson Barthrone to finish the quest.

Notes

Steps 2 and 3 are as reported by players who finished it.

Rewards

Reward
Gold600
Character XP26,250
Quest points3

Unlocks

Agauton Mine

Finishing this quest opens the old gold mine in the Wastelands: a slide shut it, and both ways into it stay closed until you have helped Wilson Barthrone.

Inside: 8 Gold rocks, 8 Silver rocks.

You can also get in from Midland Mine.

From the Binxonia news, Update: Three Ladders and a Furnace (12 Sep 2026); what is inside is what players have recorded there.
